build_ngrams: build unigram and bigram counts from wiki text files and save as JSON
tokenize: tokenize text into tokens using language-aware tokenization for CJK and space-separated languages
simple_tokenizer: tokenize text by splitting on whitespace and treating CJK characters as individual tokens
remove_html_tags: remove HTML tags and encoded angle brackets from text strings
count_ngrams: count unigram and bigram frequencies from a list of tokens with punctuation filtering
